title: last30days vs Web Search: Which Should Your Agent Use?
summary: Use web search for canonical facts. Use last30days when recent community and market signal is the point.
author: OpenAgent.bot Editors
seoTitle: last30days vs Web Search for AI Agent Research
seoDescription: Compare last30days with ordinary web search for recency-sensitive AI agent research workflows.
body: Ordinary web search and [last30days](/skills/last30days-skill) answer different questions.

Use web search when the best answer is a stable page: official docs, pricing, release notes, standards, or company pages. Use last30days when the useful answer is distributed across recent posts, comments, videos, repositories, and prediction markets.
| Product docs and API reference | Web search |
| Founder, project, or market pulse | last30days |
Start with last30days to discover the recent signal. Then use web search or official docs to verify any factual claim before publishing, buying, or building.
